content: ATS job APIs (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby) are all public JSON but structurally divergent: different pagination, date formats (Lever epoch ms vs Greenhouse ISO), remote-status representations (Ashby isRemote boolean, Lever workplaceType enum, Greenhouse only 'Remote' in location string). Key reliability needs: stable IDs for dedupe, retries with backoff on 429/5xx, per-company error isolation so one dead slug doesn't kill a 200-company run, delta logic for new/changed postings only. Lever returns 404 for unknown slugs; companies migrate ATS platforms silently.
